references.text: Basic instructions regarding the peace offering (שְׁלָמִים), which is the type of sacrifice mentioned here in Numbers 7:77.
Detailed laws concerning the peace offering, including how the meat was to be eaten and offered.
The first time this identical peace offering formula is mentioned in chapter 7, at Nahshon's offering.
Pagiel son of Ocran's complete offering is introduced here, and verse 77 marks the conclusion of his gifts.
Summary of all the peace offerings given by the tribal leaders, including Pagiel's contribution.
Pagiel son of Ocran is identified as the leader of the tribe of Asher, the same person who brings this offering.
Pagiel son of Ocran is first mentioned here as the representative for the tribe of Asher.
